It's a lifetime suite, and it's yours anytime you need it during your stay in Septimont.|Lupa during {{Quest|Shadow of Glory}} }} '''Leonidas Hotel''' is a [[Point of Interest]] located in {{Location|Capitoline Hill}}. ==Overview== Leonidas Hotel is a popular hotel with front view and elevator access to the arena of Colosseum Olymdos. It difficult to book a room without reservations done months in advance, especially during the [[Great Agon]] season.
It is adorned with rotating gold plates, a mechanic scarab on-top of the entranceway, and a rooftop greenhouse. [[Lupa]] obtained a life-time suite for herself and [[Rover]]. ==Related Dialogues== {{Dialogue Start}} ;During {{Quest|Shadow of Glory}} :'''Tourist:''' If we'd booked tickets six months ago, we wouldn't be stuck camping out here! :'''Another Tourist:''' Who knew the Leonidas Hotel would be this packed? I can't even call in to book a room… Wasn't this hard last year. :'''Another Tourist:''' And those prices… Let 'em stay if they want to, but I'm not paying that. What's wrong with a tent, anyway? :'''Tourist:''' This is the Great Agon, after all! Ugh, fine. It is what it is this time, but next time, you'll follow my lead. ---- :'''Worker in a Butler Suit:''' These outfits are so different from what we normally wear... :'''Worker in a Maid Dress:''' I can't agree more. Although, I still prefer our normal ones. They're more comfortable to wear. {{Dialogue End}} ==NPCs== {{NPCs by Location List|Leonidas Hotel}} ==Notable Interactions== * [[The Great Agon Schedule]] * [[Daily Scoop]] * [[A Traveler's Guide to Septimont]] ==Soundtracks== {{Soundtracks by Category Table|type=location}} ==Gallery== Leonidas Hotel Interior.png|Leonidas Hotel Suite Leonidas Hotel Interior2.png|Leonidas Hotel Coliseum View ==Trivia== * Gladiator Leonidas was the King of Sparta and a legendary warrior of ancient Greece. * There is also a chocolate confectionery called Leonidas Chocolate Gold Coin with an embossed image of a Spartan Gladiator.
